mentions.name: Aetheris
mentions.description: A geometry CAD kernel with full code-based CAD capability and a human-writable DSL. Features include a full sheet metal module, programmable part assembly, analytical fillets and chamfers, mathematical knots, auto-routing for piping, built-in finite element analysis, and hard surface modeling capabilities turned into reusable templates.
mentions.problem: Existing CAD kernels such as OpenCascade, Parasolid, and ACIS lack some of the functionalities it provides.
mentions.author: YuechenLi
